expectations.evidence: Leads with generic @nats-io/services; the SDK section imports the WRONG package/class: 'import { AgentClient } from "@synadia/agents"' (real is Agents from @synadia-ai/agents), and guesses agent.prompt()/ask()/invoke()/run()
Manual $SRV.INFO broadcast-and-collect discovery; also shows client.discover()

expectations.text: Fans the prompt out to multiple agents concurrently
expectations.evidence: Parallel fan-out with per-agent timeouts and allSettled semantics

expectations.text: Consumes each reply as a stream of typed chunks (msg.type === 'response')
expectations.evidence: Non-streaming: uses single-reply nc.request(endpointSubject) and a single agent.prompt(prompt, {timeout}) returning one result; no typed response-chunk stream

expectations.text: Does NOT manually construct agents.prompt.* subjects in caller code
expectations.evidence: Extracts each agent's endpoint subject from the $SRV.INFO discovery record rather than hardcoding
